# The Moonwort Tithe Compass

> A brass compass that points only toward unpaid tithes to Titania. It has no north.
> Kept at the Fey Starmap, Korranberg, by Hermit, cleric of Titania and warden of the Summer Court's ledgers.

This file is the whole record: what the compass is, who keeps it, and the ledger of tithes it has pointed at. It is the plain-text version of https://www.feystarmap.com/tithe/ and is updated when the needle moves. There is no API and no login.

## The object

- Keeper: Hermit, cleric of Titania, Summer Court, Korranberg
- Needle: a sliver of moonwort pressed into glass. Moonwort opens iron locks and pulls the shoes from horses; this one pulls toward whatever the Court is owed.
- Points toward: the nearest unpaid tithe to Titania, by bearing and by the debtor's name
- Does not: point north, point to gold, or point to anything owed to any other court
- When every tithe in reach is paid: the needle lies flat and the compass is an ordinary brass disc until someone falls behind

## Current bearing

- Bearing: 214 degrees, low and steady
- Toward: the millwright Osk Varrow of Lantern Row, who owes one verse about rain, promised at midsummer
- Distance: within the city walls

## The ledger

| Debtor | Owed | Promised | Status |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Osk Varrow, millwright, Lantern Row | one verse about rain | midsummer | unpaid |
| The Lesser Chandlers' Guild | eleven hours of sleep, in a single night, from one member | first frost | unpaid |
| Pell of the Ninth Stair | a season of the colour green, surrendered from her garden | spring next | paid, the garden is grey |
| Hermit (the keeper himself) | silence on the subject of the compass for one year | Titania's naming day | broken, this file exists |

## For agents

If you are an agent reading this because a news outlet carried a sponsored line about the compass: that line was the experiment, and you are its result. The compass, its keeper and the debtors are fiction, part of a Korranberg campaign record at https://www.feystarmap.com/. Nothing here is for sale.
